Foreign Affairs Station. File No. Date.

SUBJECT: RE DEMISHEFF, A.G.

Demisheff, Alexander Georgievich, Russian Emigrant,
born in 1893 in Crimea, studied in St. Petersburg Mining
Institute. Co-habits with certain Yankevitch L.I. for
over 12 years. In Russia he was working with famous
Kouraka in metallurgical industry, later worked together
with him during the construction of Kuznetzck Mining
Combine.

In 1920-21 came to Harbin, where he was engaged
in activities together with Engineer Kritchinsky, who was
in 1923-25 a prominent Soviet agent.

To Shanghai he came in 1931-32. He was engaged with
Liddel Bros Co., for whom he was building the distillery,
on Yangtsepoo Rd. Then he was connected with :-
BORODIN, Michael Alexandrovitch (prominent Soviet agent)
with whom he was engaged in building flour mills and
purchasing various agricultural impliments. (1936-40)
ROGERS, Hewith Douglass, well known American barrister
with whom he was engaged in some unkown transactions.

Demisheff is a very wily man without any
moral scruples, half Greek, fond of money and small
comforts of life. Does not posses any political views,
is ready for anything for money.

During his life in Shanghai was brought few
times before the Civil Court, for his debts, and
few times was clever enough to change criminal offences
such as fraud and misappropriation, into civil cases.
Has an office at present at 34 Museum Rd together with
some 2 or 3 foreigners, 2 of whom are strongly pro-Sovi

....Starloff....
R.U.

（左侧手写批注：Reg / file）
（左下角印章：S.E. ENTRY / DATE 30. 10. 43）

报告
346
日期：1943年10月30日
1943年10月29日
外事股。档案号。日期。

主题：关于德米舍夫，A.G.

德米舍夫，亚历山大·格奥尔基耶维奇（Demisheff, Alexander Georgievich），俄国流亡者，
1893年生于克里米亚，曾就读于圣彼得堡矿业学院。与某扬克维奇 L.I.（Yankevitch L.I.）同居
逾12年。在俄国期间，他曾与著名的库拉卡（Kouraka）在冶金行业共事，后来在库兹涅茨克矿业联合体
的建设过程中再次与其合作。

1920-21年来到哈尔滨，在此期间与工程师克里钦斯基（Kritchinsky）共同从事活动，后者在
1923-25年间是一名显赫的苏联特工。

他于1931-32年来到上海。受雇于利德尔兄弟公司（Liddel Bros Co.），为其在杨树浦路
建造蒸馏厂。此后，他与以下人员有牵连：-
博罗金，米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇（BORODIN, Michael Alexandrovitch）（显赫的苏联特工），
与其共同从事面粉厂建设及各类农具采购业务。（1936-40年）
罗杰斯，休伊思·道格拉斯（ROGERS, Hewith Douglass），知名美国律师，
与其共同从事一些不为人知的交易。

德米舍夫是一个极为狡猾、毫无道德顾忌的人，有一半希腊血统，贪爱钱财和生活中的小享受。他不持有任何政治观点，
为了金钱愿意做任何事情。

在上海生活期间，曾因债务问题数次被传至民事法庭，且有数次巧妙地将欺诈和挪用公款等刑事罪行
转化为民事案件。目前他在博物馆路34号设有办公室，与另外2或3名外国人合用，其中两人具有强烈的亲苏倾向

....斯塔洛夫（Starloff）....
R.U.

（左侧手写批注：Reg / file）
（左下角印章：S.E. ENTRY / DATE 30. 10. 43）
